applicable_rules.description: Duplicate monitoring entries should be reconciled
applicable_rules.constraint: The same measurement at the same scheduled times should appear only once in the active schedule; duplicate entries should be merged or one should be discontinued.

consistency_findings.rationale: Orders 1 and 2 specify the same measurement at the same times with the same conditions, creating duplicate entries under rule 1.
consistency_findings.suggested_resolution: Confirm that the entries represent the same intended monitoring plan, then retain one order and remove or merge the duplicate.
